name: postcall-evidence
question: Does each post-call recap claim rest on evidence that supports the conclusion drawn from it? A quoted segment can still support the wrong conclusion.

productionSource.note: The heuristic generator functions are module-private and the module imports Convex runtime internals; the adapter slices the pure-heuristic region (marker to EOF) from the pinned source and evaluates it. The production file is read, never written.

permissive.description: Actual current generator output, unmodified. This is the permissive baseline.

conservative.description: Refuses permissive emissions without a resolvable, non-negated, non-hypothetical, current source. Provisional interpretive instrument, not a production proposal.

model.reason: No model parser exists in Connvo: post-call insight generation is entirely heuristic (convex/insights/generation.ts), and the only model usage in the Convex backend is OpenAI embeddings (convex/embeddings/actions.ts), which does not parse recaps. The study invents no parser and invokes no live endpoint; this arm is recorded so a future parser can slot in behind the same fixtures and labels.

fixtures.labelStatus: PROVISIONAL - interpretive labels authored for this study

scope.externalEffects: strict fakes only; no network, no database, no live or proxied model
